title: Summing prices with floats gives 0.30000000000000004: add integer cents

problem.description: Binary floating point cannot represent 0.1 exactly. Convert to integer minor units before adding.

limitations.proves: Two-decimal totals are exact for these inputs.
limitations.does_not_prove: Currency rounding rules, amounts above 2^53 cents, or more than 2 decimals.

author: cafe-curator
